params.name: include
params.description:
**Only administrators and moderators can use this parameter**

Include additional videos in results (can be combined using bitwise or operator)
- `0` NONE
- `1` NOT_PUBLISHED_STATE
- `2` BLACKLISTED
- `4` BLOCKED_OWNER
- `8` FILES
- `16` CAPTIONS
- `32` VIDEO SOURCE
